scope_policy: Finish carpentry, millwork and manufactured casework only; base bid only — alternates excluded (list them).
Include: P-lam base and wall cabinets, reception counters, mailbox units, hardware, white oak sills and trim, scribes/fillers, grommets, countertop substrates when part of casework scope.

Exclude unless asked: countertop surfaces (stone, solid surface, HPDL by others), plumbing fixtures, electrical in casework, wood doors and frames, rough carpentry, general conditions, bonds, sales tax.
exclusiones_base: Plumbing fixtures and electrical/data devices in casework.
Wood doors, frames and door hardware.
Rough carpentry, blocking in walls and backing panels (by GC/framer).
Performance and payment bonds; Washington State sales tax (resale to GC).
supuestos_base: Pricing is for the base bid only; alternates are excluded unless listed.

scope_excluir.motivo: Díaz no hace superficies de cubierta: van con el sub de countertops (p.ej. JC Granite).
